about: 内核怎么读域名和 TXT 内容的正则：每一条都放进一份最小配置，跑 kixdns 79e8fd5 的 config::validate 得到（规则的 domain_regex、入口的 domain_regex、回答条件的 request_domain_regex、TXT 的 response_txt_content 四处结果一样）。error 是内核报的原因（去掉前面的「compile configuration: 」），null 是内核收。面板服务端的正则检查（crates/panel-server/src/regex_check.rs）和页面（web/src/config-model/regex-check.ts）都拿它测 / How the kernel reads name and TXT content regexes: each was put into a minimal config and run through the config::validate of kixdns 79e8fd5 (domain_regex in a rule, domain_regex in an entry, request_domain_regex in an answer condition and response_txt_content agree). error is the cause the kernel gives (without the leading 「compile configuration: 」), null that the kernel takes it. The panel server regex check and the page are both tested on it.
